title: Building a stream processing pipeline in context of risk management platform

blocks.html:
Unbounded data streams are all around us and smart use of them may unlock a variety of new opportunities for businesses to grow.
The need for systems to react in real-time to thousands of events per second is crucial these days, and stream processing is addressing this requirement thoroughly.
During this talk, we will discover why and how to apply stream processing, in order to build a pipeline to accomplish different goals and meet non-functional requirements.
As an example, we are going to use a risk management platform to discuss the challenges and issues that can be encountered during the design and implementation phases.
